title: Declined troubleshooting or additional details
summary: This topic centers on customers declining troubleshooting, offers, or requests for more details, with only a few fragments expressing clear dissatisfaction tied to unresolved support handoffs.

negative.summary: Negative fragments describe unresolved issues where customers deferred further troubleshooting or were redirected elsewhere for additional details and support.

undetermined.summary: Most fragments only note that customers declined an offer, troubleshooting, or providing more information, without enough context to determine satisfaction.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short and lack enough context to determine why the customer declined or how they felt about the interaction.
The topic includes several related but not identical situations, including declining troubleshooting, declining offers, and not providing additional details.
